summary: MONEY MAP (Phase 14): Across all 36 registry gaps the PROBLEM and USER links are identifiable in 36/36 (mostly FACT/HIGH), so the red team's 35 kills are not about fake problems - they are about money that has no door. Using a strict test (a new entrant can name a paying office AND an open or recurring vehicle for THIS function), only 3 gaps have an identifiable path: G04 (conditional - FACT-level chain CNO N2N6 -> PEO C4I/NAVWAR GPNTS -> NAVWAR SBIR-CSO, but only SBIR-scale money, no program line found, and topic DON26BX05-NP004 closed 2026-09-23, verified this session), G06 (path exists but Rune/Gallatin were selected in 2026) and G10 (path exists but prime-captured by UNO/NGC2 transport incumbents). The other 33 have NO identifiable path (major penalty). Weakest link across all 36: REQUIREMENT OWNER 14 gaps (split ownership, government building its own tool, or no one has asked), PROGRAM OFFICE 8, BUDGET 4, CONTRACT VEHICLE 8 (designated to Anduril/Palantir/Raft/Applied Intuition, prime-sized single awards, or legally inaccessible: Link 16/VMF and NCDSMO cross-domain; also G04's closed topic window), and CURRENT VENDORS 2 (G06, G10 - path exists but occupied). Failure modes: BROKEN-BUDGET=4, BROKEN-PROGRAM=7, BROKEN-REQUIREMENT=12, CLOSED-WINDOW=1, INACCESSIBLE=2, NON-DOD-BUYER=3, OCCUPIED=2, OCCUPIED-BY-DESIGNATION=5. Where the money actually is (FACT unless noted): Army NGC2 ~$3B FY26 request with a 50% obligation cap, FY27 request ~$3.78B (C2 Applications $488.4M RDT&E, C2 Data $306.1M, Infrastructure and Transport ~$1.36B each; HASC mark -$710M); joint MSS + JFN >$2B FY27; DAF ABMS PE 0604003F ~$1.04B FY27; Space Force $38.4B RDT&E FY27 incl. $1.5B Automate Sat C2. Startup-accessible slices are SBIR/xTech/CSO prototypes ($75k-$2M) and team-member subcontracts - never the headline lines. Data corrections flagged: (1) several gap cards and the Army buyer chain attribute the $488.4M/$306.1M NGC2 sub-lines to FY26; this session's check places them in the FY27 request (MEDIUM). (2) ABMS FY26 is inconsistent (>$871M allocated per ExecutiveBiz vs $1,040.5M request per CRS in E05) - unresolved, LOW-MEDIUM. (3) Drone Dominance/DAWG FY27 request reported as $53.6B (G09) vs $54.6B (G25). (4) JFN program office stand-up date differs between buyer files (Oct 2025 vs Feb 2026). PROCUREMENT STAGES (Phase 15): Emerging 2, Prototyping 10, Transitioning 17, Mature 5, Stagnant 2. Transitioning dominates, but transition in 2025-26 happened by designation to platforms or selection of already-funded startups, which is why Transitioning markets still kill these gaps. G12 (coalition COP) and G20 (ITV) are reclassified Stagnant. PROTO-PURGATORY (Phase 16): WARNING (institutional barriers) for coalition/MPE/releasability, track fusion, ATO/authorization, ITV and commercial ISR-to-tactical; OPPORTUNITY (vendor-solvable, proven when commercial firms delivered) for EW/spectrum SA and contested-logistics decision support - but both are now captured by 2026 awardees; MIXED for DDIL sync/data layers, tactical zero trust, autonomy orchestration, battalion C2 and edge PED. Official SBIR transition data do not exist (GAO-25-107942); DIU reports 51% of completed prototypes transitioned FY2016-2023 (GAO-25-106856), where 'transition' means any production contract, not fielding. BUYER MAP (Deliverable 3): the doors most relevant to software startups in 2026 are Army NGC2 (team-lead onboarding and the PM C2 Applications storefront RFI of May 2026), SSC Kronos CSO and UDL, AFWERX -> TACFI with PAE C3BM/ACC, CDAO Tradewinds, JIATF-401 and DIU CSOs, USSOCOM PEO-SDA, and NAVWAR open topics. Eligibility is the binding constraint: SBIR/STTR was reauthorized through 2031 (P.L. 119-83, signed 2026-04-13, per law-firm alerts) with expanded foreign-affiliation due diligence, and the >50% U.S. citizen/LPR ownership test is likely unmet today - cap-table, export-control (ITAR/EAR deemed exports) and FOCI questions need counsel; nothing here is a legal judgment.
